source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import json
with open('/root/autodl-tmp/distrib_canary_collapse/results/phase_diagram/t20_a060_s43_fp32/analysis/5method_leadlag.json') as f:
    d = json.load(f)

# Extract only essential per-pair data (no all_lags)
compact = {
    "meta": d["meta"],
    "pairs": [],
    "consensus": d["consensus"],
    "summary": d["summary"]
}
for p in d["pairs"]:
    cp = {"canary": p["canary"], "downstream": p["downstream"], "forward": {}, "reverse": {}}
    for direction in ["forward", "reverse"]:
        for method_name, method_data in p[direction].items():
            md = {k: v for k, v in method_data.items() if k != "all_lags"}
            cp[direction][method_name] = md
    compact["pairs"].append(cp)

with open('/tmp/5method_compact_final.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(compact, f, indent=2)

# Also output a summary for direct reading  
print("=== SUMMARY ===")
print(json.dumps(compact["summary"], indent=2))
print("\n=== PermG RAW P-VALUES (forward) ===")
for p in compact["pairs"]:
    pg = p["forward"]["perm_granger"]
    print(f"  {p['canary']:<16} -> {p['downstream']:<12} raw={pg['p_value']:.6f}  fdr={pg['p_fdr']:.6f}  sig_fdr={pg['significant_fdr']}")
print("\n=== TY FORWARD ===")
for p in compact["pairs"]:
    ty = p["forward"]["ty_granger"]
    print(f"  {p['canary']:<16} -> {p['downstream']:<12} p={ty['p_value']:.4f}  sig={ty['significant']}  d_max={ty['d_max']}")
print("\n=== TY REVERSE ===")
for p in compact["pairs"]:
    ty = p["reverse"]["ty_granger"]
    print(f"  {p['downstream']:<16} -> {p['canary']:<12} p={ty['p_value']:.4f}  sig={ty['significant']}  d_max={ty['d_max']}")

# K>=4 count
k4 = sum(1 for c in compact["consensus"] if c["votes"] >= 4)
print(f"\nrobust_pairs_K4: {k4}/8")
PYEOF
